Usually in cases like yours, where the application from the inside is kind of in line with regulations, I would expect them to grant at least a one-time reentry. The bigger issues are often with people who apply from a tourist visa in violation of the regulations, since not granting the reentry is seen by some case workers as a tool to make them leave and wait abroad for the invite. 
This is of course an assessment based on individual stories. But I think if you persist, you should be able to secure that permit.
